definition: [ פָּלָה ] verb Niph`al be separated, distinct (|| form of פלא q. v.; compare Arabic , separate from sucking, wean ; Ethiopic separate, distinguish ); — 1. Perfect 1 plural consecutive וְנִפְלִינוּ Exod 33:16 and we shall be distinct , with מִן person 2. 1 singular נִפְלֵיתִי Ps 139:14 I am wonderful (namely in bodily stature etc.); < Vrss Hupfeld Now Bae We תָ - thou [ ׳ י ] art wonderful ( פלא 3 ). Hiph`il Perfect 3 masculine singular הִפְלָה Ps 4:4 , ׳ וְה consecutive Exod 9:4 1 singular וְהִפְלֵיתִי consecutive Exod 8:18 Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַפְלֶה Exod 11:7 Imperative masculine singular הַפְלֵה Ps 17:7 — of ׳ י , make separate , with accusative Exod 8:18 (by treating differently); set apart Ps 4:4 , but perhaps read חֶסֶד לִי (for Mt חָסִיד לוֺ ), hath made wonderful (his) kindness to me ( Dy Gr Che We Du [ Bae 'perhaps']), so Ps 17:7 (compare Ps 31:22 ); distinguish between, בֵּין thing, Exod 9:4 , בֵּין person Exod 11:7 .

[פָּלָה] verb Niph`al be separated, distinct (|| form of פלא q. v.; compare Arabic , separate from sucking, wean; Ethiopic separate, distinguish); —

1. Perfect 1 plural consecutive וְנִפְלִינוּ Exod 33:16 and we shall be distinct, with מִן person
2. 1 singular נִפְלֵיתִי Ps 139:14 I am wonderful (namely in bodily stature etc.); < Vrss Hupfeld Now Bae We תָ- thou [׳י] art wonderful (פלא 3). Hiph`il Perfect 3 masculine singular הִפְלָה Ps 4:4, ׳וְה consecutive Exod 9:4 1 singular וְהִפְלֵיתִי consecutive Exod 8:18 Imperfect 3 masculine singular יַפְלֶה Exod 11:7 Imperative masculine singular הַפְלֵה Ps 17:7 — of ׳י, make separate, with accusative Exod 8:18 (by treating differently); set apart Ps 4:4, but perhaps read חֶסֶד לִי (for Mt חָסִיד לוֺ), hath made wonderful (his) kindness to me (Dy Gr Che We Du [Bae 'perhaps']), so Ps 17:7 (compare Ps 31:22); distinguish between, בֵּין thing, Exod 9:4, בֵּין person Exod 11:7.
